Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de date pentru sisteme IT
About Ragnar Solutions 
 Ragnar Solutions Romania is the Romanian branch of Ragnar Solutions BV, a growing software company based in the Netherlands.We build and maintain Deimos , an e-invoicing integration platform used for compliance accross PEPPOL (multi-country), France, Poland, Spain and more. E-invoicing is becoming mandatory in more and more countries, but every country has different rules, formats, and government systems. Deimos handles that complexity for our clients, helping make sure their invoices are processed correctly and delivered to the right systems on time.
 About the Role 
 If AI writes all your code then this position is not for you. 
 We are looking for a Mid-level Full-Stack Developer to join the team building Deimos. You will own features end to end: from the CSV/SFTP intake and the background jobs that talk to national e-invoicing systems (Poland's KSeF, Spain's VeriFactu, the Peppol network) through to the Angular portals where clients see the result.
 Our Stack 
 How it's built 
A multi-tenant platform: two Angular portals (client and admin), an API gateway in front of two ASP.NET Core APIs, and multiple .NET background services
Services talk over RabbitMQ; calls to external systems go through an outbox with idempotent retries
Integrations over REST, SOAP and SFTP, with XML built and validated against official schemas (Peppol BIS / UBL, Poland's FA(3))
BackendC# 14 on .NET 10, ASP.NET Core
Entity Framework Core with PostgreSQL
RabbitMQ, Serilog
xUnit and Moq
Front-endAngular 20, standalone components and signals
TypeScript, RxJS, Tailwind CSS
Nx monorepo with libraries shared by both portals
Playwright for end-to-end tests
Tooling and InfrastructureDocker and Docker Compose
GitLab CI for builds, tests and deployments
HashiCorp Vault for configuration and secrets
 What you will do 
Own features across backend, frontend, tests and docs
Build and maintain integrations with national e-invoicing authorities
Work with XML schemas: build documents, validate them, debug rejections from the authority
Design background jobs: import pipelines, outbox-based sync workers, retries, idempotency
Investigate production issues independently across services (logs, queues, database)
Keep tenant isolation and authorization intact in everything you touch
Review code and mentor junior developers
 What we are looking for 
3+ years professional C#/.NET, including ASP.NET Core APIs
Solid EF Core and relational DB skills (PostgreSQL preferred): migrations, indexing, query performance
Angular + TypeScript + RxJS, comfortable with forms, tables, reusable components; signals a plus
Message-based / asynchronous processing (RabbitMQ or similar): at-least-once delivery, idempotency, retries
Unit and integration tests as part of "done" (xUnit, Moq)
Comfortable integrating third-party APIs (REST, SOAP) and reading XML/XSD
Can debug a distributed issue on your own
Git/PR workflow, gives useful code review
 Nice to have 
E-invoicing, Peppol, UBL or any tax-authority integration
Multi-tenant SaaS
Docker Compose, GitLab CI, Vault
File-based integrations (SFTP, CSV)
Auth: JWT, FIDO2/passkeys, RBAC
Nx monorepos, Playwright
 What we offer 
Salary range between 7000 and 11000 RON (net), depending on experience
Remote/hybrid working environment
Meal tickets
Medlife Gold private medical insurance
End of year bonus
Performance bonus
Access to courses for continued professional development
 Our hiring process 
We keep it short and transparent: Intro call to talk about your background, the role, and what you are looking for.
Take-home assignment, described below.
Technical discussion (around an hour) where we go through your assignment together.
Final conversation with the team, and an offer.
 About the take-home assignment 
 The assignment is a small full-stack task scoped to around 4 hours: a .NET API that accepts invoice-like records, a background worker that processes them from a queue (idempotent, with retries), and a small Angular page that shows the outcome. We care about how you structure and test it, not about polish. You have one week to hand it in.
